notes: Explore idea: Sinkhorn optimal transport (Cuturi 2013) as the twelfth research-algorithms tool, wasserstein-distance. Exact 1-D W1/W2 with moved-up/moved-down split and W2^2 location/spread/shape; several columns by stabilised Sinkhorn with a certified bracket on the exact cost (AWR 2017 rounding above, double c-transform dual below); energy permutation test. Verified vs POT 0.9.7/SciPy 1.17.1: 1-D to 1e-12, plan to 1e-10, bracket contains ot.emd2 on all cases. Finding: Central Park July nights 1991-2020 vs 1951-1980 up 0.789 C at every quantile (p 0.001), days unchanged (p 0.445); 2-D W1 bracket 0.843-0.891 contains exact 0.8747. No agent doc: nothing the next run needs beyond the README and research-tools candidate list (updated).
